briefing.headline: OpenAI deploys GPT-6 agents as US-China compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate multi-agent deployments while regulatory scrutiny mounts. US export controls on advanced chips tighten further amid Chinese model releases.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships GPT-6 with native agent orchestration; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V4 matches performance at lower cost. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 2M units; Google TPU v6 clusters online in Iowa; xAI breaks ground on Memphis supercluster expansion.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will agentic AI systems trigger mandatory licensing regimes by Q4 2027?
